Game Overview

Impostor Duck Online is a io game built around quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Impostor Duck Online is easy to pick up. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Impostor Duck Online?

Impostor Duck Online is a free io game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Impostor Duck Online free to play?

Yes, Impostor Duck Online is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
